$comment: Single source of truth for the advertised-protocol-version <-> Hounfour dependency mapping. tests/unit/protocol-version-parity.test.ts fails when runtime, docs, or the dependency drift from this file without an explicit update here.
reason: Dixie advertises the protocol contract surface it implements: DynamicContract 8.2.0 (cycle-007, Sprint 76). The @0xhoneyjar/loa-hounfour package is consumed at 8.6.0 for additive (minor-version, backward-compatible) schema and validator changes that do not alter the advertised contract surface. Bumping the advertised version requires a deliberate contract-surface review, not a dependency bump.
update_procedure: When DIXIE_PROTOCOL_VERSION or the Hounfour dependency changes: update this file, state the compatibility rationale in the PR description, and mention the mapping in release notes.
